question: An engineer must use the Embedded Event Manager to monitor events that occur on a Cisco Nexus 9000 Series Switch. An environment variable needs to be created so that several policies use the monitored events in their actions. The external email server is represented by IP address 10.10.10.10. Which command sets the environment variable?
options: n9k2(config)# event manager policy environment mailserver "10.10.10.10"
theory: EEM environment variables are defined globally in configuration mode with 'event manager environment variable-name value', which makes that variable available to any and all EEM policies rather than being scoped to a single applet — so the syntax must be 'n9k2(config)# event manager environment mailserver "10.10.10.10"'. There is no equivalent exec-mode or applet-submode command, and 'event manager policy environment' is not valid EEM syntax. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 16 — Automation and Scripting Tools)
